title: euodia lepta var. roxburghiana
intro: Euodia lepta var. roxburghiana, commonly known as Roxburgh's Euodia, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family, native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may aid in reducing fever, relieving pain, and fighting infections. The therapeutic actions of Roxburgh's Euodia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities. Further studies are needed to fully explore the medicinal properties of Euodia lepta var. roxburghiana, but its traditional use suggests it may be useful in treating various health conditions.
